name: sci-skills
description: Joe's research-writing skill families for Claude Code — paper writing chain, degree-thesis assembly from published papers, figure drawing, and experimental data analysis.

plugins.name: sci-skills
plugins.description: Shared sci-skills utilities — figure drawing (sci-draw) and project scaffolding (article-init, thesis-init).

plugins.name: sci-skills-article
plugins.description: Article family — the paper writing chain: sci-write, sci-story, sci-polish, sci-typeset, sci-respond, sci-export, sci-submit.

plugins.name: sci-skills-thesis
plugins.description: Thesis family — turn N published papers into a degree thesis (重组延伸, not from-scratch): spine, dissect, intro, theory, summary, polish (thesis-init scaffolding lives in the sci-skills plugin).

plugins.name: sci-skills-analysis
plugins.description: Data-analysis family — turn experimental data into publication-ready figures and tables. Bundles xps (XPS peak fitting: calibration, background subtraction, Shirley/Tougaard, chemical-state assignment).
